A3-01.atk: a small hurried puff of wind flicks loose notebook pages, a thin airy whistle, then a light papery slap and fluttering leaves
A3-01.def: no barrier yet, the frail apprentice stumbles: a soft cloth rustle, a startled little gasp of air, pages scattering across a stone floor

A3-02.ko: 깃펜 긋고 정전기 톡 · 책장 덮음
A3-02.atk: a quill scratches once across parchment, a dry static crackle gathers, then a small sharp zap pops off the page tip
A3-02.def: a heavy ledger is snapped shut in front of the body: a dull paper thud, a soft dust puff, ink bottle clinking as the scribe backs off

A3-04.ko: 책 더미 와르르 · 책 속에 웅크림
A3-04.atk: a stack of books slides off a shelf: leather slaps, a short breathy puff of wind, then a muffled bump of a thick tome landing
A3-04.def: curled up under falling books: several soft hollow thuds of binding, dust hissing out, a small muffled thump from a thin body

A3-05.ko: 깃털 살랑 스침 · 깃털 타고 사뿐 피함
A3-05.atk: a single feather whirls up on a soft breeze, a gentle hushed swish, then a tiny airy tick as its barbs strike the target
A3-05.def: the mage floats away on a feather: a weightless fluttering swirl, silk robe rustling, the hit only brushing past with a faint whisper of air

A3-07.ko: 돌풍이 먼저 튀어나감 · 옷자락 펄럭 흔들림
A3-07.atk: an impatient gust bursts out early: a sharp rising whoosh, a short wind slap that cracks against the foe, robes snapping behind
A3-07.def: a hasty gust thrown up too late: a ragged puff, flapping fabric, then the body knocked sideways with a soft sandy scuff

A3-09.ko: 별 문자 베끼고 바람 탁 · 두루마리로 막음
A3-09.atk: a scratching stylus on a parchment scroll, a small pulse of breeze, then a crisp papery whip and a little tapping thud
A3-09.def: a rolled scroll raised to catch the blow: a stiff paper knock, a muted ringing of a brass ink pot, one clumsy foot scrape on stairs

A3-10.ko: 작은 회오리 마당에서 휘몰아침 · 휩쓸려 비틀
A3-10.atk: a loose spiraling whirl builds, dust and gravel hissing round, then it lurches forward with an uneven roar and a clattering burst of debris
A3-10.def: unable to stop its own spin: a wobbling spiral of air, rattling pebbles, a clumsy stumble and a soft thump on stone

A3-11.ko: 바람 타고 쏜살 돌진 · 휙 비켜섬
A3-11.atk: a rapid streak: a quick tearing zip of air, a satchel strap slapping, then a snappy gust-punch arriving before its own echo
A3-11.def: a nimble sidestep on a gust: a short whip of air, boots skidding on gravel, a leather satchel swinging with a light creak

A3-13.ko: 먹구름 빗방울 번개 톡 · 책장으로 비 가림
A3-13.atk: pages flip open, fat raindrops patter, a low cloud rumble swells and a thin lightning snap cracks down on the foe
A3-13.def: rain-slick robes and a raised open book: raindrops drumming on parchment, a damp thud, a distant soft thunder murmur

A3-15.ko: 바람 이름대로 가르는 칼바람 · 공기 흩어 빗나감
A3-15.atk: a smooth breath-like swell, then a long clean slicing gust that sweeps across in one graceful arc ending in a crisp airy hiss
A3-15.def: an effortless parting of air around the body: a gentle whirling sigh, hair and silk streaming, the blow slipping through with a hush

A3-16.ko: 결계 엮고 마력 탁 · 화살이 맴돌다 풀림
A3-16.atk: woven air lines tighten with a taut humming thrum, a bright magical pulse leaps out and snaps with a glassy crack
A3-16.def: a lattice of wind catches the strike: a spinning hum of trapped air, a faint arrow whistle circling and fading, a shimmering settle

A3-18.ko: 몸을 축 삼은 회오리 · 고요한 중심
A3-18.atk: a body-centered spiral winds tighter with a rising low howl, then flings outward with a rushing roar and a heavy whooshing impact
A3-18.def: a calm hollow inside a spinning wall: a steady circular roar outside, a muffled deep swirl, the blow shredded into whispering streamers

A3-19.ko: 오만한 손짓 뇌우 한 줄기 · 구름 휘장 튕김
A3-19.atk: a disdainful snap of fingers, a charged crackle, a thunderclap jolt, then a hard rolling boom with spitting static
A3-19.def: a curtain of dark cloud swirls up: damp rumbling air, a heavy muffled thud against it, sparks fizzling out proud and slow

A3-20.ko: 별빛 맑은 종소리 번뜩 · 별빛 휘장
A3-20.atk: a clear glass-bell tone rings once, a thin starlight shimmer rises, then a precise bright crack lashes at the foe
A3-20.def: a veil of starlit air: a held crystalline hum, a soft glassy ripple as the blow dissolves, faint twinkling flecks sinking

A3-22.ko: 기압 뚝 떨어져 진공 · 공기 빠져나감
A3-22.atk: the air pressure drops: a sucking vacuum hush, a limp snapping flag, then a sudden heavy slam of rushing air returning with a deep thump
A3-22.def: fingertips weigh the air: a stiff pressured hum, the hit sliding off a dense cushion of compressed wind with a muffled pop

A3-23.ko: 고서 펼치고 마력 슉 · 두꺼운 책으로 막음
A3-23.atk: a heavy tome opens with a creak, dry pages riffle, then a narrow cutting stream of air whips out with a sharp papery hiss
A3-23.def: a thick book held up as a shield: a solid leathery knock, a soft ring of brass corners, dust puffing from the pages

A3-24.ko: 구름 속 우르릉 번개 낙하 · 구름 베개처럼 삼킴
A3-24.atk: a low brooding cloud rumble tightens, static crawls, then a hard sizzling bolt cracks down followed by a rolling boom
A3-24.def: a thick mass of storm cloud swallows the strike: muffled damp rumble, faint sparks fizzing deep inside, a heavy cottony thud

A3-26.ko: 하늘에 글자 쓰고 폭풍 강림 · 폭풍이 휘감음
A3-26.atk: a stylus line etches a sparkling hiss across the sky, the sky groans, then a hammering gale and thunderclap crash down
A3-26.def: a storm drops around the body: layered howling wind, rain lashing on a barrier, the blow thudding into a swirling wall of storm

A3-28.ko: 낮은 바람 소리 뒤 고요한 일격 · 바람 속으로 사라짐
A3-28.atk: a soft hollow wind-sigh over high rocks, a pause, then a long deep gust sweeps through with a haunting airy whistle
A3-28.def: the pilgrim dissolves into the breeze: a hollow rushing sigh, thin high whistling over open air, the strike swallowed by soft wind

A3-29.ko: 서가 쾅 내려치는 책 · 서가가 막아줌
A3-29.atk: a tall ladder rattles, a thick stack of books is flung: heavy slapping bindings, gusting pages, a booming wooden slam on impact
A3-29.def: a bookshelf wall: heavy wooden bump, creaking shelf, volumes thudding off, dust and loose pages swirling after

A3-30.atk: a stormbird shrieks briefly overhead, great wing beats thrash, then a diving gust and a raking talon slash with a crackle of static
A3-30.def: big feathered wings fold in front: thick flapping, a muffled feather thump, a short angry bird cry, static sparks ticking

A3-31.ko: 파편 섬의 조각돌 바람 · 바람 속 암석이 맴돎
A3-31.atk: floating shards chime together, a low old wind begins, then fragments of stone whip past with a hollow rushing whistle and clatter
A3-31.def: drifting shards orbit and clink: glassy stone ticks, a slow circling breeze, the blow deflected with a gentle echoing knock

A3-32.ko: 회오리 셋 겹쳐 휩쓸기 · 겹겹이 도는 방패
A3-32.atk: three whirlwinds of different pitch wind together, pages flapping inside, then collapse forward in a thundering layered roar
A3-32.def: three spinning columns around the body: layered rushing hums, the strike chewed apart with a low grinding whirr and fluttering paper

A3-33.ko: 천 눈 로브 펄럭임과 울림 · 로브 눈 깜박
A3-33.atk: a deep resonant gong-like hum under heavy robe rustle, a cold pressure wave, then a single vast crack of air pulsing outward
A3-33.def: a huge robe unfurls: dense cloth rustle, a wet blink-like flutter, the impact absorbed into a deep resonant tone fading slowly

A3-34.ko: 머리 위 번개구름 왕관 · 구름이 첫 타격 흡수
A3-34.atk: a crown of cloud above rumbles, lightning flickers, then a wide branching bolt splits the air with a ringing crack and thunder
A3-34.def: the overhead cloud ring flares: a swelling thunder rumble, static arcs spitting, the blow dispersed in sparks with a muted boom

A3-35.ko: 하늘 가르는 가늘고 긴 칼 · 칼날로 쳐냄
A3-35.atk: a thin blade drawn, wind gathers on its edge with a rising keening, then one long ripping slice tears across the air like torn silk
A3-35.def: a swift parry: a ringing steel scrape, the cut aside in a thin whistling swish, a brief cloud-torn hiss trailing

A3-36.ko: 열쇠 짤랑 뇌우 소집 · 탑이 흔들림
A3-36.atk: a heavy key jingles, a stately tower bell tone hums, then a mighty thunderclap and surging gust crash down together
A3-36.def: a thick ward from the tower: a deep resonant stone thrum, a metallic key chime, the blow ringing out dully against it

A3-41.ko: 소리 삼키는 고요 · 칼바람 숨 죽임
A3-41.atk: barely any attack: a soft hush of air, a faint damp pull, then a muffled gentle push like a pillow of still air
A3-41.def: a bubble of silence: sounds vacuum into a hollow soft hum, a wall-like dull thud, then even the blade-wind stops with a faint sigh

A3-42.ko: 폭풍 눈 속 가시 · 고요 단단하게 막음
A3-42.atk: a calm hush, then a thorn of compressed air jabs out with a short stinging whistle and sharp snap
A3-42.def: a rock-solid core of calm inside a roaring storm: a deep wall of wind rings out, a heavy thud, then a thin counter-slash of spiking air

SP-A3.ko: 별빛 화살 연발 · 별빛 장벽 울림
SP-A3.atk: starry crackles gather, a luminous bowstring-like thrum with no arrow, then multiple streaking star-bolts whistle and burst on impact with a deep boom
SP-A3.def: a luminous wall of ascended wind: a high crystalline chime, a deep cosmic hum, the strike scattering into twinkling glass-like sparks

UN-A3.ko: 별 문자 읽고 선제 · 주문을 미리 흩음
UN-A3.atk: a pre-emptive pulse, a clear soft bell, then a precise slicing gust that arrives just before the motion
UN-A3.def: an eye of calm: the incoming spell is seen and blown away early, a thin glassy chime, a gentle opened-pages flutter, then stillness

UN-A3-7.ko: 주문 삼키는 흡입 · 마력 삼켜 울림
UN-A3-7.atk: a deep inhaling vacuum gulps the air, a charged hum swells, then it unleashes a heavy swelling gust with a booming crack
UN-A3-7.def: the incoming magic is drawn in: a sucking whoosh, a resonant swallowing hum, a bright shimmer swelling and settling

EP-A3-1.ko: 화살 없는 시위와 바람 화살 · 바람 틈 비켜섬
EP-A3-1.atk: a drawn string thrum with no arrow, a bright whistling streak of wind, then a pinpoint star-glyph snap on target
EP-A3-1.def: a quick sidestep with a flick of a cloak: an arrow-like whistle passing close, a puff of air, a soft landing step

EP-A3-2.atk: a layered storm swells in pitch, a first thunderclap rolls, then a doubled echoing second clap follows with crackling static ringing out wide
EP-A3-2.def: the first blade parted by a charged cloud: a bright sizzle, a deflected steel zing, a distant resonant rumble

EP-A3-3.ko: 하늘 요람 관문 활 · 관문 같은 방어
EP-A3-3.atk: a long watchful silence, a huge bow-like thrum, then two heavy streaking bolts whistle with a deep boom and thunder tail
EP-A3-3.def: a vast gate of wind: a heavy low groan, a ringing boom, the strike absorbed into a high lonely whistling

PN-A3-C1.ko: 별 문자 베끼다 탁 · 버티며 서 있음
PN-A3-C1.atk: a stylus scratch, a brisk snap of paper, then a small tight puff of wind thumps
PN-A3-C1.def: bracing against the blow: a wooden stair creak, an unmoved stubborn scuff, a papery thud

PN-A3-C3.ko: 바람 갑옷 창 · 늘 같은 두께
PN-A3-C3.atk: a thin lance of wind released with a taut snap and whistling travel, striking with a crisp ring
PN-A3-C3.def: a constant-thickness cloak of wind: a steady unwavering hum, a solid ringing knock, no flutter at all

PN-A3-U1.atk: a glyph etched with a scratchy crackle, a crisp whistle, then a sharp engraved pop
PN-A3-U1.def: carved glyph-wind holds its shape: a resilient humming shell, a scratchy etched shimmer, the hit bouncing off with a firm tap

PN-A3-U2.atk: a heavy gate-like creak, a rush of wind surging forward, then a booming punch of magic
PN-A3-U2.def: an immovable sluice-gate: a deep metallic thrum, the strike ringing off with a sealed hush

PN-A3-R.ko: 천 눈 한 자락 · 미리 본 듯 막음
PN-A3-R.atk: a soft eye-like blink flutter, a long thin piercing whistle, then a precise crack at distance
PN-A3-R.def: robe corner flicks aside before the blow: a seen-in-advance hush, a firm rustle, a small tonal ring

PN-A3-E.ko: 스승의 별 문자 · 버티며 별 읽음
PN-A3-E.atk: a calm clear bell, a starry streak whistling out, then a bright cascade of magical impacts
PN-A3-E.def: a steady reading pose: a gentle page-turn flutter, a firm unwavering tone, the blow stilled with a soft chime

UP-A3-10.atk: a tightly controlled spiral snaps out with a roaring crack, then a disciplined scything gust cuts through
UP-A3-10.def: a snuffed cyclone in hand: a sudden quiet, a dense swirling hum, a short ringing deflection

UP-A3-11.ko: 바람보다 먼저 닿음 · 바람 속 안착
UP-A3-11.atk: a sonic-boom-like snap before its own whoosh, a streaking rush, then a heavy swift punch
UP-A3-11.def: landing softly inside a gust: a bright whistle swirling around, a spring-like thud, a calm settle

UP-A3-18.atk: several cyclones merge: a resounding rising roar, then a huge wall of wind surges forward with a thundering boom
UP-A3-18.def: a rank of woven whirls: a layered roaring wall, the strike swallowed with a deep grinding hum

UP-A3-23.ko: 별이 숨긴 것 읽음 · 별빛 책 방패
UP-A3-23.atk: a tome snaps open, starlit chime rings, then a refined needle-thin gust pierces with a crystalline crack
UP-A3-23.def: a book of stars: a luminous page flutter, glassy tone, the blow dissolved into a soft glimmer

UP-A3-24.atk: a baton-like swish, a clustered thunder swell, then one precisely aimed bolt cracking down with a ringing boom
UP-A3-24.def: a cloud turned like a sail: rolling damp rumble, sparks guided around, the strike redirected with a hissing crackle

MA-03.cast: a cold draining sigh: a thin hiss of air slipping out, a limp muscle-slackening sink in pitch, then a faint soft clatter as strength drops away

SA3-01.cast: a sharp wedge of wind rattles armor seams with metallic ticks, then the same gust curls behind with a warm rising push and billowing cloth

SA3-02.cast: an invisible wall thickens with a swelling hum, a swung blade whooshes in and sticks with a soft sudden drag, air rippling like taut glass

MA-07.cast: a quill scratches a long line, chalk taps, then a bright ringing chime sweeps across and every sound levels into one equal hum

MC-06.cast: a twisting whirl wrenches at hilts, leather grips squeak, then many weapons clatter and skid away across stone on a fading gust

SA3-04.cast: a tower bell tone, the sky groans, then a roaring gale settles behind with thunder rolling and blades crackling with static

SA3-05.cast: a coiling cyclone winds around one spot with tightening howl, ropes of air creaking, then far arrows whistle off scattered into hush

MA-11.cast: a sly gust passes, steel and wood clink swapping places, a quick fluttering shuffle, then a short dropped-clatter of surprise

SA3-06.cast: a storm is forged: thunder hammered into a bright edge with a ringing scrape, then a hurled blade whistles and slices with a crack

SA3-08.ko: 전장 가득 몸 가누기 힘든 바람
SA3-08.cast: a vast wind rises across a field, banners snapping, a long deep howl with rolling thunder, then a heavy stilling pressure drop

RA3-1.cast: a roar of wind spins up around, then suddenly drops to a vacuum-like hush, a faint ringing in the stillness and a soft draining tick

NA3-1.cast: a narrow keening wind picks at plate seams with tiny tin rattles, rivets popping, then metal flaps like cloth in a ragged hiss

NA3-2.cast: a deep churning funnel rumbles across open land, debris roaring, then three small twisters whip off with sharp whirring hits in sequence

NA3-3.cast: wind whets blade edges with a rising fine hiss like a grindstone, tips ring sharp, and a thin penetrating whistle cuts through

NA3-4.cast: a shimmering glass-like fold of air, a wide whoosh sweeping sideways as figures swap, then a sharp ringing pop and a heavy knock

HA3-1.cast: a sly gust slips through, cards riffle and flick, two quick paper slaps swap places, then a tiny mischievous flutter and a pause

HA3-2.ko: 같은 얼굴 둘 중 하나 데려감
HA3-2.cast: a glassy mirror chime doubled, an echo-like shimmer, then a card slides across the table drawn by a soft gust and lands with a tap

US-A3-1.cast: a star-bright ring, glyph scratches etching, then opponents' cards dim with a falling drained hush as one fresh card flips with a snap

US-A3-2.cast: a thousand lids open with soft wet flutters, a vast deep pressure hum settles, then drawn blades and spells freeze with a sharp stillness

PS-A3-1.cast: three soft chime ticks rotate in circle, a wheeling whirr of air, a wooden gear clicking, then a hollow settling thud

PS-A3-2.cast: a quill scratch as a copy is written, a rising swirling hum, then glowing pulses press into allies with soft resonant pings

RS-A3-1.cast: two slim blades of wind whistle in sharp succession, each ends in a dry cutting snap on cloth, the second higher than the first

RS-A3-2.cast: a reverse howl blows hard down the stair, blades blunt against a wall of air and rebound with a whipping slap and a rough cutting hiss

RS-A3-3.cast: a roaring cyclone thick with thin ringing blades, rapid slicing zips in a spinning flurry, then a deepening lowering sink of weakened air

CS-A3.cast: a spell hums into being, a thin taut thread of sound is cut with a bright snip, then it fizzles and dies with a soft puff

C2-1.equip: a worn grimoire is handed over and clasped: a leather strap buckles, a stiff cover creaks, pages riffle, one tiny gust puffs from the spine

C3-1.equip: a staff is gripped, its cap clinks, a tiny caged storm hums with static crackle, a short sharp spark jumps from the tip

IA3-3.equip: a cloak is swung over the shoulders: heavy silk unfurls with a whoosh, a brooch clasps, then a gentle wind curls around with a soft whirl

IA3-4.equip: a thick book is opened and its pages turn one by one, each releasing a quick whirl of air, a faint spinning roar curling out of the binding

IA3-5.equip: a long staff is planted with a deep wooden knock, a pure resonant tone hums outward, starry shimmer drifts, and a long breeze whistles over it

IA3-6.equip: a glass orb is set in a cradle with a smooth clink, static builds into a pulsing hum, and a small bright lightning snap flicks inside

SR-A3.equip: a long quill is dipped and tapped on an inkwell, a scratch of nib on vellum, a swelling resonant hum, and an authoritative amplified snap of air

IR-A3.equip: a long scroll is unrolled with a papery crackle, a bone roller thunks, glyphs hiss with faint fizzing and the air seems to sway aimlessly

PI-A3.equip: a heavy mirror is unveiled: silk slides off, a deep glass-bell tone rings, a frozen crystalline stillness settles with a final hard glassy lock

TS-A3-1.cast: a tiny glittering streak falls with a high thin whistle, then a brief crystalline ping and a faint scatter of fine dust

TS-A3-2.cast: a squat twister spins up in an eager whirr, grit rattling, then strikes one target with a sudden whipping slap

TS-A3-3.cast: a faint dry spark popping from stirred air, a brief glowing sizzle, then a little tick against the foremost armor

TS-A3-4.cast: a single clear tap that echoes back as a second softer one, two light impacts bouncing off front lines with a hollow ring
